        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(s);
        int i = 0;
        while (i < sb.length()) {

                sb.replace(i, i + 3, ".");
                i += 1; // move past the replaced character
            } else {
                i++;
            }
        }
        System.out.print(sb.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
